name: Robinhood Chain
blockscoutApiNote: Cloudflare/backend gives 403 or 500 to server-side calls and /api/v2/* is flaky even from the in-app browser. The Etherscan-compat path `/api?module=...&action=...` (e.g. action=getcontractcreation) does answer intermittently from the in-app browser and is the only reason the launchpad attribution below could be confirmed. NOT a runtime dependency (spec §8.1 / post-M3 checkpoint) — best-effort only, behind AddressHistoryProvider in M4.
getLogsMaxRangeNote: blockmachine.io caps eth_getLogs at (toBlock-fromBlock) <= 10000, i.e. a 9999 inclusive span. M4 rpc-budget probes on boot ([9999, 5000, 2000]) and overrides this. ordofi tolerated ~2000 before flapping.
rpcNote: 2026-09-06: RH_RPC_URL is https://rpc-robinhood.blockmachine.io. ordofi (rpc.ordofi.network) archive is currently broken (missing trie node at depth) and eth_getLogs returns -32005 'network is busy' unpredictably. Tested alternatives: official rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com works for small queries but hard-throttles 'Too Many Requests'; Pocket (robinhood.api.pocket.network) is non-archive; publicnode needs a paid token. blockmachine serves archive + gives clean 'rate limit exceeded' (retryable) but throttles ~12-request bursts. A keyed / dedicated node is the production answer.

v4PoolManager.note: Contract name PoolManager; deployed via the deterministic CREATE2 deployer 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C. ~$29M TVL, 28.8k txns, ~48 Initialize events per 2000 blocks (2026-09-04). This is the primary launch venue on 4663.

v3Factory.note: Blockscout metadata_tag UniswapV3Factory; same deployer (0x9701fb0aDe1E269c8f64Ec0C7b3cfADB31A13A52) as the v2 factory tag. Alternate is the cross-chain canonical address, also tagged. No PoolCreated seen in a small live window — confirm range/address from a real v3 launch before trusting.

v2Factory.note: Blockscout metadata_tag UniswapV2Factory; emits PairCreated live (~2 per 2000 blocks, 2026-09-04). LONG's stock-paired pools may land here.

v4Quoter.evidence: quoteExactInputSingle returned a live quote for the CAPY/ETH pool via eth_call (2026-09-05); address also in Uniswap's own v4 deployments doc.
v4Quoter.note: V4Quoter. Used for our own quote-based sell impact (spec §3.3.7 / §3.3.9), sized to 100 and 1,000 USDG notionals in M4 (checkpoint 8.4). v3/v2 sell-impact quotes are not wired (v3 barely used on 4663).

quoteAssets.note: Quote/base assets. Used to tell the new token from the paired asset in a fresh pool, and (later) for liquidity_usd_10m + sell_impact_bps (spec §3.3.7). USDG confirmed from a real v4 Initialize + Blockscout token page (verified). WETH has several deployments on 4663; both verified candidates included. M4 (checkpoint 8.6) also treats any pair side whose code is >24h old at pool creation as the quote side (tokenized stocks that LONG pairs against).

launchpadVerificationMethod: On-chain only. Do NOT navigate to launchpad marketing sites — several impostor sites on this ecosystem phish for seed phrases. Primary attribution is by RUNTIME CODE HASH (launchpad tokens share a template): keccak256(eth_getCode(token)), or a masked hash when the template splices per-token address immutables into the runtime, or the implementation address for minimal-proxy pads. Factory / entrypoint address is the corroborating signal. To confirm a pad: get a labelled token (user-supplied, or a listing on defillama.com / dexscreener.com), then `GET /api?module=contract&action=getcontractcreation&contractaddresses=<token>` on Blockscout from the in-app browser for contractFactory + creation tx, and eth_getCode for the template fingerprint. Record template + factory + specimen tx, set verified:true.
launchpadAttributionNote: M4 packages/chain attributeSource() must be updated to: (1) hash-match against each verified pad's template (exact codeHash, maskedCodeHash over immutableRanges, or implementation address), then (2) fall back to factory/entrypoint match, then (3) source:'raw'. Until that lands, all launches are still source:'raw'.
lpLockedByConstructionPolicy: true ONLY after verifying one real position's custody on-chain (position NFT owner, or a hook that blocks removal) — never from pad docs (checkpoint 8.2). Every pad below is currently false: no custody check has been done. SELL_IMPAIRED / LIQ_IMPAIRED keep being scored for all of them (the conservative direction).

launchpads.label: Pons
launchpads.lpLockedByConstructionNote: Pons docs claim the curve LP is locked; not verified on-chain yet. Flip only after checking a real Pons position's custody.

template.note: ERC-20 with three 20-byte address immutables spliced into the runtime at these byte offsets (creator + 2 protocol addresses; all vary per token). Zero those ranges before keccak256(runtime) to match every Pons token. Raw $ORBIO codehash 0x67d7a9d1677c238d9dae8679f500586f7d189e7bcda59964f3ce634dcf7363cf is per-token, not a fingerprint. 33 of 200 recent launches sampled had the 3248-byte length.
